args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production — failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all three regions.
2. **Rollback attempt**: Tried to roll back to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, but it's quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and cannot be deployed.
3. **Fallback rollback**: Rolled back to v2.2.9, the next most recent release that was healthy in production. This succeeded in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the outage, the quarantined version, the fallback rollback, and the current healthy status; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.0 will need the CVE remediated before it can be a rollback target again, and the v2.3.1 regression should be investigated before any re-deploy.
